notes.title: NEW FUTURE DELUXE UPDATE TEASER! - 📢
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="VOao07RPPtA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b][i]In this teaser, we show you a little bit of the game's new look, locations, lighting, and evolution in the designs.[/i][/b][/p][p]We promised to change everything, be it the gameplay, the visuals, [b]and include a new storyline[/b]. We've listened to many requests and criticism. Now, the minigames will no longer be mandatory and you can follow a new story, with different events and achievements to unlock.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The update contains more secrets and places to explore. If you haven't purchased the game yet, add it to your wishlist and wait for the next update!![/b][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: GAME LAUNCH
notes.content:
[h1]Miller's Fantasy will be released on the 31st costing 5.99 dollars and 10.49 reais BR[/h1]

ːsteamthumbsupː I thank everyone who helped, promoted, made art and supported the game, in the future we will have Miller's Fantasy PARK, a game from the same universe but in 3D!

[i]IMPORTANT NOTICE: the game is not recommended for children under 16, it contains...[/i]

Bloody
Exposed flesh
Dismemberments
Blood
Deaths
